description: Prepares a sale, without changing anything: `connect_store` (the link to connect their Shopify store), `preview` (the product as it would go online, at their price), `page_brief` (facts, photos and outline for a product page), `first_sale` (the video and where to post it), `amazon_fees` (what Amazon keeps on a sale), `batch` (a batch delivered to them or to Amazon).

price.description: preview / amazon_fees: the selling price THEY chose; Rabbit suggests none.

product.description: The product reference returned by Rabbit (starts with “p”).

store.description: connect_store: their .myshopify.com address, if they said it.

variant.description: preview: the variant number from the preview.

name: sell
title: Sell
